Home / Activities

How can we help you?

All our services are free, offered by volunteers who want to share what has given them peace and purpose.

Visit our church

Come to our Sunday service, no strings attached. Feel peace and draw closer to God: you can stay as long as you like and no one will ask anything of you.

Learn more →

Scripture Study

Come and study the Book of Mormon and the Bible with us. Free sessions, no commitment, with missionaries who guide you at your own pace.

Come and study →

Family History

Discover your roots and connect with your ancestors. We help you for free with FamilySearch.

Learn more →

English and Spanish Classes

Learn English or Spanish for free with our native-speaker missionaries. Practical, fun classes for all levels.

Learn more →

Family Home Evenings

Weekly activities to make friends, play, learn and enjoy a community that welcomes you with open arms.

Learn more →

Community Service

Join our community service projects. Together we can make a real difference.

Learn more →

Support and Well-being

Emotional support and recovery programs. You are not alone — we are here to walk with you through difficult times.

Learn more →

Institute

Weekly gatherings for young people: a lesson about Jesus Christ, games and food. A place of faith, friendship and lots of fun.

Learn more →

All our services are free

We are volunteer missionaries giving our time to serve in Spain. Our desire is simply to share what has given us hope and happiness.
